🎥🎬: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005)

Harry Lockhart is a small-time thief who accidentally stumbles into an acting audition while fleeing the police. His unexpected performance earns him a trip to Hollywood, where he is paired with private detective Perry van Shrike to prepare for a crime film role. But what begins as an unusual acting opportunity quickly turns into a real-life murder investigation.

When Harry reconnects with Harmony Faith Lane, a woman from his childhood whom he has secretly admired for years, he finds himself caught in a complicated mystery involving suspicious deaths, Hollywood secrets, and people who aren’t quite who they claim to be. As Harry and Perry investigate, their partnership becomes increasingly chaotic, with Harry’s terrible luck and Perry’s sharp instincts creating an unlikely detective duo.

Between unexpected twists, dark humour, and a dangerous web of deception, Harry discovers that surviving Hollywood might be even harder than surviving a crime scene. Kiss Kiss Bang Bang is a hilarious neo-noir mystery that blends crime, comedy, and unexpected friendship.

source_details.synopsis: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang is a 2005 American neo-noir black comedy crime film written and directed by Shane Black (in his directorial debut) and starring Robert Downey Jr., Val Kilmer, Michelle Monaghan, and Corbin Bernsen. The script is partially based on the Brett Halliday novel Bodies Are Where You Find Them (1941) and interprets the classic hardboiled literary genre in a tongue-in-cheek fashion. The film was produced by Joel Silver, with Susan Levin and Steve Richards as executive producers. Shot in Los Angeles between February 24 and May 3, 2004, the film debuted at the 2005 Cannes Film Festival on May 14, 2005, and was released in the United States on October 21, 2005.
